question_evidence_quote: the number of girls and boys was the same since some of the girls were not able to join the trip.
observed_error: The equation subtracts absent girls from the boys' count.
violated_condition: With x girls absent, the equality of attending girls and boys requires 10 - x = 8.
error_description: The response writes 10 = 8 - x even though x counts girls unable to attend. This reduces the eight boys instead of the ten girls. The attendance condition requires subtracting x from the initial girls' count before equating it to the unchanged boys' count; the subsequent arithmetic correctly solves the wrong equation.
